title: Kirby Problem 1.79
exact_target: Find efficiently discoverable extra diagram moves that simplify every unknot by strictly decreasing the crossing count at each simplification step.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 2738 (KP-1.79). CC BY 4.0.
